career_history.title: Junior Information Secruity Engineer

I conducted audits across AWS, GCP, platforms, endpoints, applications, and firewalls. Performed code inspections, and collaborated with developers in Golang, TypeScript, and Node.js environments.

career_history.title: Data Centre Sales Specialist
career_history.description: I engaged customers on datacentre challenges, leveraging partner portfolios (Nvidia, VMWare, HPE, Dell, VAST Data) to design solutions. I worked with containerization, Kubernetes, hypervisors, hyper-converged infrastructure, governance, and disaster recovery technologies.
